text: The initiative features a blended approach of US$95 million in development policy budget support and a US$30 million Cat-DDO, which can be rapidly drawn following a qualifying disaster. It builds on a previous 2021 Cat-DDO, demonstrating continuity and scaling up in ambition and financing. The program focuses on fiscal resilience, private sector enabling measures, and divisional disaster planning, with co-benefits in public health and regulatory simplification.

metadata.solution_name: Fiji Growth and Resilience First Development Policy Financing with a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat-DDO)
